title: BundlePair
description: Two codes that a published coding edit says are normally billed together. code_1 is the primary code; code_2 is the code the edit says should not be billed separately. Matches the pipeline's ncci_pairs record. Used by /core for possible_unbundling flags.

code_2.description: Code that is normally part of code_1. The flag is placed on the line with this code.

modifier_indicator.description: "0" the pair may not be billed together; "1" may be billed together only with an appropriate modifier; "9" the edit does not apply (ignored by /core).

data_source.description: Where this pair came from. Required and non-empty.

data_year.description: Year the pair is from. Required.
